component.name: algolrevived
component.summary: A font revival of Frutiger's Algol alphabet

description.p: This font revives Frutiger's Algol alphabet, designed in 1963 for the code segments in an ALGOL manual. OpenType and type1, regular and medium weights, upright and slanted. Not monospaced, but good for listings if you don't need code to be aligned with specific columns. It also makes a passable but limited text font.
